verses.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְהִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־ סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֛ה הָגְל֥וּ לְבָבֶ֖ל בְּמַעֲלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl hiṯ·yaḥ·śū wə·hin·nām kə·ṯū·ḇîm ‘al- sê·p̄er mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh hā·ḡə·lū lə·ḇā·ḇel bə·ma·‘ă·lām
verses.literal: So all Israel was recorded in the genealogies . . . written in the Book of the Kings of Israel But Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness
verses.literalPt: Foi todo o Israel contado por genealogias e inscrito nos livros dos reis de Israel; e Judá foi levado cativo para Babilônia por causa da sua transgressão.

verses.original: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hay·yō·wō·šə·ḇîm hā·ri·šō·nîm ’ă·šer ba·’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām bə·‘ā·rê·hem yiś·rā·’êl hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim wə·han·nə·ṯî·nîm
verses.literal: Now the first to resettle their own property in their cities were Israelites priests Levites and temple servants
verses.literalPt: Ora, os primeiros habitantes que moravam nas suas possessões nas suas cidades foram Israel, os sacerdotes, os levitas e os netinins.

verses.original: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim yā·šə·ḇū min- bə·nê yə·hū·ḏāh ū·min- bə·nê ḇin·yā·min ū·min- bə·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim ū·mə·naš·šeh
verses.literal: Some of the descendants of Judah . . . . . . Benjamin . . . . . . Ephraim and Manasseh lived in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Em Jerusalém, moravam dos filhos de Judá, dos filhos de Benjamim e dos filhos de Efraim e de Manassés:

verses.original: עוּתַ֨י בֶּן־ עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן־ עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן־ אִמְרִ֣י בֶן־ בָּנִימִן־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ū·ṯay ben- ‘am·mî·hūḏ ben- ‘ā·mə·rî ben- ’im·rî ḇen- bå̄·nī·min- bə·nê- p̄e·reṣ ben- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Uthai son of Ammihud the son of Omri the son of Imri the son of Bani a descendant of Perez son of Judah
verses.literalPt: Utai, filho de Amiúde, filho de Onri, filho de Inri, filho de Bani, dos filhos de Perez, filho de Judá.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַשִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר וּבָנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- haš·šî·lō·w·nî ‘ă·śā·yāh hab·bə·ḵō·wr ū·ḇā·nāw
verses.literal: From the Shilonites Asaiah the firstborn and his sons
verses.literalPt: Dos silonitas: o primogênito Asaías e seus filhos.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי־ זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê- ze·raḥ yə·‘ū·’êl wa·’ă·ḥê·hem šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·ṯiš·‘îm
verses.literal: From the Zerahites Jeuel and 690 . . . . . . relatives
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Zerá: Jeuel e seus irmãos, em número de seiscentos e noventa.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן־ הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ הַסְּנֻאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê bin·yā·min sal·lū ben- mə·šul·lām ben- hō·w·ḏaw·yāh ben- has·sə·nu·’āh
verses.literal: From the Benjamites . . . Sallu son of Meshullam the son of Hodaviah the son of Hassenuah
verses.literalPt: Dos filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Hodavias, filho de Hassenua;

verses.original: וְיִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֔ם וְאֵלָ֥ה בֶן־ עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־ מִכְרִ֑י וּמְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־ שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יִבְנִיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḇ·nə·yāh ben- yə·rō·ḥām wə·’ê·lāh ḇen- ‘uz·zî ben- miḵ·rî ū·mə·šul·lām ben- šə·p̄aṭ·yāh ben- rə·‘ū·’êl ben- yiḇ·nî·yāh
verses.literal: Ibneiah son of Jeroham Elah son of Uzzi the son of Michri Meshullam son of Shephatiah the son of Reuel the son of Ibnijah
verses.literalPt: Ibneias, filho de Jeorão, Elá, filho de Uzi, filho de Micri, e Mesulão, filho de Sefatias, filho de Reuel, filho de Ibnijas;

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ לְתֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥê·hem lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām tə·ša‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm wə·šiš·šāh kāl- ’êl·leh ’ă·nā·šîm rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: and 956 . . . . . . . . . of their relatives according to their genealogy All these men were heads of their families . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: e seus irmãos, segundo as suas gerações, em número de novecentos e cinquenta e seis. Todos estes homens foram cabeças das famílias nas casas de seus pais.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה וִיהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְיָכִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hak·kō·hă·nîm yə·ḏa‘·yāh wî·hō·w·yā·rîḇ wə·yā·ḵîn
verses.literal: From the priests Jedaiah Jehoiarib and Jachin
verses.literalPt: Dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, Jeoiaribe e Jaquim;

verses.original: וַעֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־ חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־ צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־ מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·zar·yāh ḇen- ḥil·qî·yāh ben- mə·šul·lām ben- ṣā·ḏō·wq ben- mə·rā·yō·wṯ ben- ’ă·ḥî·ṭūḇ nə·ḡîḏ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Azariah son of Hilkiah the son of Meshullam the son of Zadok the son of Meraioth the son of Ahitub the chief official of God’s temple
verses.literalPt: Azarias, filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, regente da Casa de Deus;

verses.original: וַעֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־ פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן־ עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־ יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן־ מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־ מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן־ אִמֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ḏā·yāh ben- yə·rō·ḥām ben- paš·ḥūr ben- mal·kî·yāh ū·ma‘·śay ben- ‘ă·ḏî·’êl ben- yaḥ·zê·rāh ben- mə·šul·lām ben- mə·šil·lê·mîṯ ben- ’im·mêr
verses.literal: Adaiah son of Jeroham the son of Pashhur the son of Malchijah Maasai son of Adiel the son of Jahzerah the son of Meshullam the son of Meshillemith the son of Immer
verses.literalPt: Adaías, filho de Jeroão, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias, e Masai, filho de Adiel, filho de Jazera, filho de Mesulão, filho de Mesilemite, filho de Imer,

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥê·hem rā·šîm lə·ḇêṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’e·lep̄ ū·šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šiš·šîm gib·bō·w·rê ḥêl mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏaṯ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: and 1,760 . . . . . . . . . of their relatives the heads of their families . . . able men for the work of the service of the house of God
verses.literalPt: e seus irmãos, cabeças das suas famílias, em número de mil e setecentos e sessenta, homens ilustres em valor para a obra do ministério da Casa de Deus.

verses.original: וּמִֽן־ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־ חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־ עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן־ בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hal·wî·yim šə·ma‘·yāh ḇen- ḥaš·šūḇ ben- ‘az·rî·qām ben- ḥă·šaḇ·yāh min- bə·nê mə·rā·rî
verses.literal: From the Levites Shemaiah son of Hasshub the son of Azrikam the son of Hashabiah . . . a descendant of Merari
verses.literalPt: Dos levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, dos filhos de Merari;

verses.original: וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־ מִיכָ֔א בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן־ אָסָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇaq·baq·qar ḥe·reš wə·ḡā·lāl ū·mat·tan·yāh ben- mî·ḵā ben- ziḵ·rî ben- ’ā·sāp̄
verses.literal: Bakbakkar Heresh Galal and Mattaniah son of Mica the son of Zichri the son of Asaph
verses.literalPt: Baquebacar, Heres, Galal e Matanias, filho de Mica, filho de Zicri, filho de Asafe;

verses.original: וְעֹבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן־ שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־ יְדוּת֑וּן וּבֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן־ אָסָא֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh ben- šə·ma‘·yāh ben- gā·lāl ben- yə·ḏū·ṯūn ū·ḇe·reḵ·yāh ḇen- ’ā·sā ben- ’el·qā·nāh hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḥaṣ·rê nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Obadiah son of Shemaiah the son of Galal the son of Jeduthun and Berechiah son of Asa the son of Elkanah who lived in the villages of the Netophathites
verses.literalPt: Obadias, filho de Semaías, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum, e Berequias, filho de Asa, filho de Elcana, que morava nas vilas dos netofatitas.

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šō·‘ă·rîm šal·lūm wə·‘aq·qūḇ wə·ṭal·mōn wa·’ă·ḥî·mān wa·’ă·ḥî·hem šal·lūm hā·rōš
verses.literal: These were the gatekeepers Shallum Akkub Talmon Ahiman and their relatives Shallum was their chief
verses.literalPt: Os porteiros: Salum, Acube, Talmom, Aimã e seus irmãos (dos quais Salum foi o chefe;

verses.original: וְֽעַד־ הֵ֔נָּה בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָה הֵ֚מָּה הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְמַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḏ- hên·nāh bə·ša·‘ar ham·me·leḵ miz·rā·ḥāh hêm·māh haš·šō·‘ă·rîm lə·ma·ḥă·nō·wṯ bə·nê lê·wî
verses.literal: he was previously stationed at the King’s Gate on the east side These were the gatekeepers from the camp of the Levites . . .
verses.literalPt: o qual até agora assistia à porta do rei, que ficava ao oriente). Estes foram os porteiros para os arraiais dos filhos de Levi.

verses.original: וְשַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן־ ק֠וֹרֵא בֶּן־ אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן־ קֹ֜רַח וְֽאֶחָ֧יו לְבֵית־ אָבִ֣יו הַקָּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסִּפִּ֖ים לָאֹ֑הֶל וַאֲבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַמָּבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šal·lūm ben- qō·w·rê ben- ’eḇ·yā·sāp̄ ben- qō·raḥ wə·’e·ḥāw lə·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇîw haq·qā·rə·ḥîm ‘al mə·le·ḵeṯ hā·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh šō·mə·rê has·sip·pîm lā·’ō·hel wa·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·hem ‘al- ma·ḥă·nêh Yah·weh šō·mə·rê ham·mā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: Shallum son of Kore the son of Ebiasaph the son of Korah and his relatives from the Korahites were assigned to guard the thresholds of the Tent just as their fathers . . . had been assigned to . . . . . . guard the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Salum, filho de Coré, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá, e seus irmãos, da casa de seu pai, os coreítas, estavam encarregados da obra do ministério, guardas das portas do tabernáculo; e seus pais tinham sido encarregados do arraial de Jeová e eram guardas da entrada;

verses.original: וּפִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה׀ עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄î·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār nā·ḡîḏ hā·yāh ‘ă·lê·hem lə·p̄ā·nîm Yah·weh ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar had been in charge of the gatekeepers and the LORD was with him
verses.literalPt: e Fineias, filho de Eleazar, os regia nesse tempo, e Jeová era com ele.

verses.original: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵar·yāh ben mə·še·lem·yāh šō·‘êr pe·ṯaḥ lə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Zacarias, filho de Meselemias, era o porteiro da porta da tenda da revelação.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām hab·bə·rū·rîm lə·šō·‘ă·rîm bas·sip·pîm mā·ṯa·yim ū·šə·nêm ‘ā·śār hêm·māh ḇə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem hiṯ·yaḥ·śām hêm·māh yis·saḏ dā·wîḏ ū·šə·mū·’êl hā·rō·’eh be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: The number of those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds was 212 . . . . . . They were registered by genealogy in their villages David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their positions of trust
verses.literalPt: Todos estes que eram escolhidos para guardar as portas eram em número de duzentos e doze. Estes foram contados por genealogias nas suas aldeias, e Davi e Samuel, o vidente, constituíram-nos no seu cargo de confiança.

verses.original: וְהֵ֨ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־ הַשְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֛ה לְבֵ֥ית־ הָאֹ֖הֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm ū·ḇə·nê·hem ‘al- haš·šə·‘ā·rîm lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh lə·ḇêṯ- hā·’ō·hel lə·miš·mā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: So they and their descendants were assigned to guard the gates of the house of the LORD the house called the Tent
verses.literalPt: Eles e seus filhos guardavam as portas da Casa de Jeová, a saber, da casa da tenda.

verses.original: לְאַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּה צָפ֥וֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ yih·yū haš·šō·‘ă·rîm miz·rāḥ yām·māh ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh wā·neḡ·bāh
verses.literal: The gatekeepers were stationed on the four sides east west north and south
verses.literalPt: Nos quatro lados, estavam os porteiros, ao oriente, ao ocidente, ao norte e ao sul.

verses.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֨ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֨וֹא לְשִׁבְעַ֧ת הַיָּמִ֛ים מֵעֵ֥ת אֶל־ עֵ֖ת עִם־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥê·hem bə·ḥaṣ·rê·hem lā·ḇō·w lə·šiḇ·‘aṯ hay·yā·mîm mê·‘êṯ ’el- ‘êṯ ‘im- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times . . . . . . to serve with them for seven-day periods . . .
verses.literalPt: Seus irmãos que moravam nas suas aldeias deviam, de tempo em tempo, vir por sete dias para servirem com eles;

verses.original: כִּ֣י בֶאֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֙עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־ הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל הָאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇe·’ĕ·mū·nāh hêm·māh ’ar·ba·‘aṯ gib·bō·rê haš·šō·‘ă·rîm hêm hal·wî·yim wə·hā·yū ‘al- hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ wə·‘al hā·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: But . . . the four chief gatekeepers . . . who were Levites were entrusted with the rooms . . . and the treasuries of the house of God
verses.literalPt: porque os quatro porteiros principais, que eram levitas, estavam num cargo de confiança, e lhes fora confiado o cuidado das câmaras e dos tesouros na Casa de Deus.

verses.original: וּסְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְהֵ֥ם עַל־ הַמַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ bêṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yā·lî·nū kî- ‘ă·lê·hem miš·me·reṯ wə·hêm ‘al- ham·map̄·tê·aḥ wə·lab·bō·qer lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God because they were responsible for guarding it . . . . . . and opening it every morning . . .
verses.literalPt: Estavam alojados à roda da Casa de Deus, cuja guarda lhes tinha sido confiada e que deviam abrir todos os dias pela manhã.

verses.original: וּמֵהֶ֖ם עַל־ כְּלֵ֣י הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ בְמִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּם וּבְמִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·hem ‘al- kə·lê hā·‘ă·ḇō·w·ḏāh kî- ḇə·mis·pār yə·ḇî·’ūm ū·ḇə·mis·pār yō·w·ṣî·’ūm
verses.literal: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in worship to count them whenever they were brought in . . . or taken out
verses.literalPt: Alguns deles estavam encarregados dos vasos do ministério, pois por conta os vasos se traziam e por conta se tiravam.

verses.original: וּמֵהֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְעַל־ הַסֹּ֙לֶת֙ וְהַיַּ֣יִן וְהַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·hem mə·mun·nîm ‘al- hak·kê·lîm wə·‘al kāl- kə·lê haq·qō·ḏeš wə·‘al- has·sō·leṯ wə·hay·ya·yin wə·haš·še·men wə·hal·lə·ḇō·w·nāh wə·hab·bə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: Others were put in charge of the furnishings . . . and other articles of the sanctuary . . . as well as the fine flour wine oil frankincense and spices
verses.literalPt: Outros também estavam encarregados dos móveis, e de todos os vasos do santuário, e da flor da farinha, do vinho, do azeite, do incenso e das especiarias.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַמִּרְקַ֖חַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm rō·qə·ḥê ham·mir·qa·ḥaṯ lab·bə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: And some of the sons of the priests mixed . . . the spices
verses.literalPt: Alguns dos filhos dos sacerdotes preparavam a confecção das especiarias.

verses.original: וּמַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן־ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַבְּכ֖וֹר לְשַׁלֻּ֣ם הַקָּרְחִ֑י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַחֲבִתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mat·tiṯ·yāh min- hal·wî·yim hū hab·bə·ḵō·wr lə·šal·lum haq·qā·rə·ḥî be·’ĕ·mū·nāh ‘al ma·‘ă·śêh ha·ḥă·ḇit·tîm
verses.literal: A Levite . . . named Mattithiah . . . the firstborn son of Shallum the Korahite was entrusted with baking the bread
verses.literalPt: Matitias, um dos levitas, que era o primogênito de Salum, coreíta, tinha o cargo de confiança sobre o que se cozia em panelas.

verses.original: וּמִן־ בְּנֵ֧י הַקְּהָתִ֛י מִן־ אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ לֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְהָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·min- bə·nê haq·qə·hā·ṯî min- ’ă·ḥê·hem ‘al- le·ḥem ham·ma·‘ă·rā·ḵeṯ lə·hā·ḵîn šab·baṯ šab·bāṯ
verses.literal: Some of their Kohathite . . . . . . relatives were responsible for preparing the rows of the showbread every Sabbath . . .
verses.literalPt: Alguns dos seus irmãos, dos filhos dos coatitas, tinham o cargo de preparar os pães da proposição para todos os sábados.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠מְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם בַּלְּשָׁכֹ֖ת פְּטִירִים כִּֽי־ יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ham·šō·rə·rîm rā·šê ’ā·ḇō·wṯ lal·wî·yim bal·lə·šā·ḵōṯ pə·ṭī·rīm kî- yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh ‘ă·lê·hem bam·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: Those who were musicians the heads of Levite families stayed in the temple chambers and were exempt from other duties because they were on duty day and night
verses.literalPt: Estes são os cantores, cabeças das famílias dos levitas, que moravam nas câmaras e estavam isentos de outros serviços, porque se ocupavam no seu ministério de dia e de noite.

verses.original: אֵלֶּה֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ lal·wî·yim lə·ṯō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām rā·šîm ’êl·leh yā·šə·ḇū ḇî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: All these were heads of Levite families chiefs . . . according to their genealogies and they lived in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Eram cabeças das famílias dos levitas, nas suas gerações, homens principais, e moravam em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וּבְגִבְע֛וֹן יָשְׁב֥וּ אֲבִֽי־ גִבְע֖וֹן יְעוּאֵל וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn yā·šə·ḇū ’ă·ḇî- ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn yə·ʿū·ʾēl wə·šêm ’iš·tōw ma·‘ă·ḵāh
verses.literal: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon His wife’s name was Maacah
verses.literalPt: Em Gibeão, moravam: Jeiel, pai de Gibeão, cuja mulher se chamava Maaca;

verses.original: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֣וּר וְקִ֔ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנֵ֖ר וְנָדָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nōw hab·bə·ḵō·wr ‘aḇ·dō·wn wə·ṣūr wə·qîš ū·ḇa·‘al wə·nêr wə·nā·ḏāḇ
verses.literal: Abdon was his firstborn son then Zur Kish Baal Ner Nadab
verses.literalPt: seu primogênito Abdom, Zur, Quis, Baal, Ner, Nadabe,

verses.original: וּגְד֣וֹר וְאַחְי֔וֹ וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה וּמִקְלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḏō·wr wə·’aḥ·yōw ū·zə·ḵar·yāh ū·miq·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Gedor Ahio Zechariah and Mikloth
verses.literalPt: Gedor, Aiô, Zacarias e Miclote.

verses.original: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שִׁמְאָ֑ם וְאַף־ הֵ֗ם נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·lō·wṯ hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- šim·’ām wə·’ap̄- hêm ne·ḡeḏ ’ă·ḥê·hem yā·šə·ḇū ḇî·rū·šā·lim ‘im- ’ă·ḥê·hem
verses.literal: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam They too lived alongside their relatives in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Miclote gerou a Simeia. Estes também moravam em Jerusalém com seus irmãos, bem defronte deles.

verses.original: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־ יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־ אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־ אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nêr hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- qîš wə·qîš hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·šā·’ūl hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān wə·’eṯ- mal·kî- šū·a‘ wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ wə·’eṯ- ’eš·bā·‘al
verses.literal: Ner was the father of Kish Kish was the father of Saul and Saul was the father of Jonathan Malchishua Abinadab and Esh-baal
verses.literalPt: Ner gerou a Quis; e Quis gerou a Saul; e Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe e a Esbaal.

verses.original: וּבֶן־ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִי־ בַ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מִיכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān mə·rîḇ bā·‘al ū·mə·rî- ḇa·‘al hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- mî·ḵāh
verses.literal: The son of Jonathan Merib-baal who was the father of Micah
verses.literalPt: O filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַחְרֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê mî·ḵāh pî·ṯō·wn wā·me·leḵ wə·ṯaḥ·rê·a‘
verses.literal: The sons of Micah Pithon Melech Tahrea, and Ahaz
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Mica: Pitom, Meleque, Tareia e Acaz.

verses.original: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יַעְרָ֔ה וְיַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־ עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מוֹצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḥāz hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ya‘·rāh wə·ya‘·rāh hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- ‘ā·le·meṯ wə·’eṯ- ‘az·mā·weṯ wə·’eṯ- zim·rî wə·zim·rî hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- mō·w·ṣā
verses.literal: Ahaz was the father of Jarah Jarah was the father of Alemeth Azmaveth and Zimri and Zimri was the father of Moza
verses.literalPt: Acaz gerou a Jara; Jara gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete e a Zinri; Zinri gerou a Moza;

verses.original: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בִּנְעָ֑א וּרְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·w·ṣā hō·w·lîḏ ’eṯ- bin·‘ā ū·rə·p̄ā·yāh ḇə·nōw ’el·‘ā·śāh ḇə·nōw ’ā·ṣêl bə·nōw
verses.literal: Moza was the father of Binea Rephaiah was his son Elasah his son and Azel his son
verses.literalPt: Moza gerou a Bineá, de quem foi filho Refaías, de quem foi filho Eleasa, de quem foi filho Azel.

verses.original: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֙כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·’ā·ṣêl šiš·šāh ḇā·nîm wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·w·ṯām ‘az·rî·qām bō·ḵə·rū wə·yiš·mā·‘êl ū·šə·‘ar·yāh wə·‘ō·ḇaḏ·yāh wə·ḥā·nān ’êl·leh bə·nê ’ā·ṣal
verses.literal: And Azel had six sons and these were their names Azrikam Bocheru Ishmael Sheariah Obadiah and Hanan These were the sons of Azel
verses.literalPt: Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes são: Azricão, Boqueru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias e Hanã; estes foram os filhos de Azel.
